verdict.rationale: An agent can connect through the official MCP server (`claude mcp add ... https://api.cfo.ai/mcp`) and hand a finance question to Ari via `edit_chats`/`inspect_chats`. Ari answers by building and updating a financial Model whose numbers can be opened, checked, and traced, and the vendor says outputs print lineage back to the source line and that it declines to sign anything it cannot verify. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that figures returned over MCP come from the engine rather than LLM text; explicit documentation that lineage is surfaced to the calling agent (the lineage claim comes from marketing llms.txt with an ambiguous referent).
